title: Reporting-Floor Pay-Down for Placed Consumer Accounts: Calculation and Reporting Floors
content:
Payment Operations calculation sheet for **Placed Consumer Accounts**: the amount of the reporting-floor pay-down and the reporting floor it is measured against.

## The pay-down

**Figure.** The balance due for the pay-down less the reporting floor, with $0.01 added, rounded to the cent (a half cent going to the even cent). The figure is rounded once, on the finished figure, and no intermediate amount is rounded.

**Pay-down.** The reporting-floor pay-down is the smallest of its rounded figure, the stage's single ACH bank-debit payment maximum and the balance due, and it is never below zero.

**Balance due for the pay-down.** The placed balance plus supplemental additions, returned payments and refunded overpayments, less consumer payments, direct payments, client credits and settlement waivers, as booked when the phone desk works the pay-down out, every payment of the handling date included.

**Windows.** For the reporting-floor pay-down, a payment, a return, a credit, a supplemental addition or an assistance decision falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.

The stage's single ACH bank-debit payment maximum is the figure for the account's stage in the Placed Consumer Accounts payment schedule.

## Reporting floors

The reporting floor is the debt type's amount in the credit reporting minimums:

| Debt type recorded on the account | Reporting floor |
|---|---|
| Medical | $500.00 |
| Auto deficiency | $250.00 |
| Private student loan | $250.00 |
| Bank card, utility, telecom, retail installment (any other debt type) | $100.00 |

## Hypothetical worked pay-downs

*Invented accounts; an invented stage maximum of $25000.00.*

| Debt type | Balance due for the pay-down | Floor | Figure | Pay-down | Balance after paying it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical | $812.40 | $500.00 | $812.40 less $500.00, plus $0.01, is $312.41 | $312.41 | $499.99 |
| Private student loan | $1640.00 | $250.00 | $1390.01 | $1390.01 | $249.99 |
| Utility | $95.00 | $100.00 | $95.00 less $100.00, plus $0.01, is below zero | $0.00 | $95.00 |

## Points of judgement

- A balance already below the floor gives a figure below zero, and the pay-down is zero.
- Payments already posted on the handling date are part of the balance due used, because the balance is taken as booked when the pay-down is worked out.
